title: Checkout failures after v2.4.1
description: Starting around 10:15, roughly a third of checkout attempts fail with a generic error. Release v2.4.1 went out at 10:02. Support is receiving 'card declined' complaints from customers whose cards are fine. Payments that do go through are slow.
deploy_notes:
v2.4.1 deployed to production at 10:02 UTC by the payments squad.
Changes in this release:
- Replaced the per-request HTTP client for the payment gateway with a pooled client (HikariCP-backed connection pool, maxPoolSize=10, connectionTimeout=30s).
- Added retry with 3 attempts and a 5s per-attempt timeout on gateway calls.
- Copy change on the order confirmation email.
No database migrations. No infrastructure changes. Previous release v2.4.0 had been stable for 9 days.
